notes.figure1_numeric_comparison: All final-paper temporal and spatial curve ordinates match the original error archive exactly (maximum absolute difference 0).
notes.figure2_numeric_comparison: All 10 density/pressure/energy/mass curves match the saved first-order structure history exactly (maximum absolute difference 0).
notes.newton_tolerance_difference: The exact Figure 2 structure archive and its original generator use 1e-11; the manuscript states a general default 1e-12. The release preserves the archived value and documents this difference.
notes.timings: Historical timing records for three alternating repetitions per scheme and gamma are present. Their medians reproduce Table 1. Wall-clock times depend on hardware and load; a fresh run is not expected to recover the same seconds.
notes.validation_scope: Saved-data redraws of all 6 figures and 3 tables were executed in MATLAB R2023a. First-order and PC solver smoke checks passed. Two complete Figure3 production runs were executed, with nonnegativity, pressure bound, species mass monotonicity, energy dissipation and aggregation checks.
notes.archived_figure3_two_species_comparison: All two-species density curves at t=1 match the saved structure history exactly (maximum absolute difference 0).
notes.figure3_production: Two and three species were independently recomputed for N=2000, dt=1e-4, T=2, gamma=20, tolerance 1e-12; all 20000 steps completed. Recomputed curves differ from archived paper curves by at most 2.5776e-9. Complete numeric histories and a reusable production driver are included.

original_source_records.role: Gamma3 row layout and color-style reference; historical last-panel snapshot substitution corrected in the public reproduction wrapper.

original_source_records.status: Completed independent two-species and three-species production simulations.
original_source_records.method: First-order frozen-mobility scalar Onsager density solve, normalized frozen-pressure diagonal reaction flow, and implicit conservative pressure-ordered upwind remapping.
original_source_records.initial_data: Cell-center samples of case_a; f=0.5*(1-tanh((x-0.25)/0.03)), s=0.5*(1+tanh((x+0.9)/0.05)); fractions [f*(1-s),f*s,1-f]. Residual forms only reduce floating-point reconstruction error.

implementation.scalar_step: Copied original scalar density/Newton functions without numerical changes; only the public function name changed.
implementation.reaction: The exact normalized diagonal matrix exponential, evaluated simultaneously for all species columns.
implementation.transport: The original implicit pressure-ordered remapping with array width generalized from 2 to m; species reconstruction uses n_i=n*phi_i for each column.
implementation.no_changes: No time adaptation, new limiter, altered growth law, changed grid, or changed timestep.

archive_comparison.interpretation: Numerically close, not bitwise identical. Original archived two-species generation used 1e-11; this new production run uses the paper default 1e-12.

validation.redraw: The replacement plot_data.mat was rendered successfully using reproduce_figure3 and visually checked.

original_source_records.runtime: MATLAB R2023a on maci64. Production simulations completed with native process permissions after a sandbox license-thread failure. This was not a numerical failure.
